50600236.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full-length GST-tagged p38alpha by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T100 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Full-length GST-tagged p38α (Invitrogen cat. no. PV3304) was immobilized on the chip surface via amine coupling. The running buffer consisted of 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5/10 mM MgCl2/1 mM EGTA/0.01% Brij-35/0.01% BSA/1 mM DTT. Compounds were tested at different ligand concentrations ranging from 0.0001 to 10 μM in 10× dilutions. Reaction mixtures were incubated for 2.5 h and fluorescence is then measured on a PerkinElmer Envision plate reader. All calculations are performed on the ratio of the two emission values (665 nm from the bound tracer 199, 616 nm from the Eu-anti-GST antibody). Successful competition by the test compound versus the fluorescent probe for the ATP binding site of the kinase is quantified by calculating the EC50 value based on a 4 parameter logistic curve fit. A Ki value is then calculated using the Cheng-Prusoff equation (Ki = (IC50)/(1 + [tracer]/Ka)). Finally, results are visualized in a heatmap which is generated the pKi values (pKi = 6 - log [Ki]).
